card.name: Words just before a price or fee
card.fires_on: Small words such as a, much, whenever, or, and the where the next word is likely a price, fee, or cost. It appears in web text about buying, selling, or paying.

modes.label: Before fee or cost
modes.description: A small word comes right before a likely word like fee, cost, or terms in text about paying.
modes.example: may request<< a>> fee for such use.

modes.label: Money amounts and spending
modes.description: Words in shopping or spending text where a price or amount is expected next.
modes.example: help you figure out how<< much>> two pounds of carrots might cost

modes.label: Price listings
modes.description: Marks inside listed prices, such as the decimal point.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of price and ticket words as the next word, so it seems to act where that word is already expected or just implied.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before the text is about to say a price, fee, or cost.
